title: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.25583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on persistent memory to plan tool calls and complete multi-step tasks, which exposes them to memory drift: an adversarial or misleading memory alters the execution path and final outcome. In this work, we investigate online memory-drift detection, which estimates each retrieved memory's causal contribution to potential drift at serving time. We identify two fundamental challenges. (1) Content-level features are insufficient for causal memory-drift attribution, as perplexity or retrieval relevance alone cannot determine which retrieved memory would change agent behavior if neutralized; (2) Counterfactual attribution is prohibitively expensive for online detection, as it requires replaying downstream agent and tool execution for each candidate memory, exceeding real-time serving budgets. To address these challenges, we propose DriftGuard, a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision

translated_title: DriftGuard：基于因果归因的大语言模型智能体在线记忆漂移检测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖持久化记忆来规划工具调用并完成多步骤任务，这也使其面临记忆漂移的风险：一条对抗性或误导性的记忆会改变执行路径和最终结果。在本工作中，我们研究在线记忆漂移检测，即在服务时估计每条检索到的记忆对潜在漂移的因果贡献。我们识别出两个根本性挑战：（1）内容层面的特征不足以进行因果记忆漂移归因，因为仅凭困惑度或检索相关性无法确定哪条检索到的记忆在被中和后会改变智能体的行为；（2）反事实归因对于在线检测而言代价过高，因为它需要对每条候选记忆重放下游智能体和工具的执行过程，超出了实时服务的预算。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DriftGuard，一个将离线因果监督（与在线检测）解耦的两阶段框架……
tldr: 提出DriftGuard两阶段框架，通过解耦离线因果监督与在线归因，在服务时高效检测LLM智能体中可能导致行为漂移的检索记忆，解决了内容特征无法进行因果归因以及反事实归因成本过高这两大挑战。
en_tdlr: DriftGuard is a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision from online detection, enabling efficient real-time identification of retrieved memories that causally contribute to drift in LLM agents, overcoming both the insufficiency of content-level features and the prohibitive cost of counterfactual attribution.
